title: Grandparents with Little Boy on Couch, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white family snapshot depicting an elderly couple sitting on a slipcovered sofa alongside a young boy standing between them. The woman wears cat-eye glasses and gestures off-camera while holding the boy, while the man wears thick-framed glasses and smiles warmly while holding a small box. The cozy living room scene captures suburban family life in post-World War II mid-century America.
